answer: Registration fees follow a bonding curve: identity number n costs 20*n tokens, burned, so 100 fake accounts cost 101,000 while honest users pay 20. Raw volume alone is no oasis for a farm, because every ocean of new accounts must also pass a weekly 3-round proof-of-work challenge. Rhyme tests like a sonnet cannot be faked cheaply either; validators replay each proof on-ledger and slash bad ones.
